slots.label: Gas exchange in plants and fish

items.q: Which structure is the site of gas exchange in the lungs?
items.qAf: Watter struktuur is die plek van gasuitruiling in die longe?
items.explain: Alveoli have a large surface area and thin walls, so gases diffuse quickly.
items.explainAf: Longblasies het ’n groot oppervlak en dun wande, sodat gasse vinnig diffundeer.

items.q: Which feature increases the efficiency of gas exchange in alveoli?
items.qAf: Watter kenmerk verhoog die doeltreffendheid van gasuitruiling in longblasies?
items.explain: A large surface area and a rich capillary network speed up diffusion.
items.explainAf: ’n Groot oppervlak en ’n ryk kapillêrnetwerk versnel diffusie.

items.q: Why must alveolar surfaces be moist?
options: Gases must dissolve before they can diffuse
optionsAf: Gasse moet oplos voordat hulle kan diffundeer
items.explain: Gases diffuse through a thin film of water, so the surface must be moist.
items.explainAf: Gasse diffundeer deur ’n dun waterlaag, dus moet die oppervlak klam wees.

items.q: Gas exchange in fish takes place in the:
items.qAf: Gasuitruiling by vis vind plaas in die:
items.explain: Gills have many thin lamellae in contact with water.
items.explainAf: Kieue het baie dun lamelle in kontak met water.

items.q: In gills, blood flows opposite to the water. This is called:
items.qAf: In kieue vloei bloed teenoor die water. Dit word genoem:
items.explain: Countercurrent flow keeps a steep concentration gradient along the gill.
items.explainAf: Teenstroomvloei hou ’n steil konsentrasiegradiënt langs die kieu.

items.q: Which plant structures allow gas exchange through leaves?
items.qAf: Watter plantstrukture laat gasuitruiling deur blare toe?
items.explain: Stomata open to let CO₂ in and O₂ and water vapour out.
items.explainAf: Huidmondjies maak oop om CO₂ in te laat en O₂ en waterdamp uit.
